vo.en: Your brain cannot move this finger.

visual.description: A man's hand is shown flat on a dark wooden table, fingers spread out in a high-contrast cinematic shot.

vo.en: Lay your palm flat on a desk. Now, tuck your middle finger tightly under your palm.

visual.description: Close-up of a hand performing the specific movement, folding the middle finger underneath so the knuckle touches the surface.

vo.en: You can lift your thumb, index, and pinky easily. But now, try to lift your ring finger.

visual.description: Macro shot of a hand struggling to lift the ring finger while the middle finger remains pinned down.

vo.en: Wait, it feels like your brain just disconnected, right? This is the creepy part.

visual.description: A tight close-up of a man's face looking confused and staring down at his hand in disbelief.

vo.en: Your middle and ring fingers share the same extensor tendon. By pinning one, you've essentially locked the other's engine.

visual.description: Dynamic 3D animation of mechanical gears or anatomical structures showing how two parts are linked together.

vo.en: Subscribe for more body hacks and comment STUCK if this worked. The truth is...

visual.description: A man quickly typing on a phone or laptop keyboard, followed by a nod towards the camera.
